CREATE TABLE users ( id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY, username VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, user_chat_id BIGINT NOT NULL, is_active BOOLEAN NOT NULL, search_text VARCHAR(255), exclude_text VARCHAR(255), created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP );
CREATE TABLE vacancies_ids ( id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY, vacancy_id BIGINT NOT NULL, user_id BIGINT NOT NULL, created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP );
